primary_repairs: Coefficient survival denominator counts intercept-only inspected outputs.
fixture_corrections: Snapshot runner excludes cwd-first imports with Python safe-path mode.
Browser CSV comparisons normalize Windows newlines; unavailable notes checked after expanding their study; width checked after plot resize.

limits: Synthetic calculations and fits only; no real pilot or performance claim.
The full suite and artifacts bind the preserved controls revision, not the subsequent shared MatchResult/viewer batch.
Live Jupyter frontend behavior is unverified; fresh-kernel execution, controlled display events, static SVG and saved HTML are verified separately.
No persisted checkpoint/resume, grid search, Optuna, automatic future retraining or package installation.
Caller owns upstream availability, feature provenance, research independence and serialized writes to a run group.
Existing pandas FutureWarning and Windows ZMQ selector warning remain nonfatal.
